cues.text: This is one ticket in Symphony, from the board to Done.
A person writes the ticket in Linear, or as an issue on a GitHub Projects board.
The daemon picks it up, and a runner starts one coding agent for it.
The agent works in its own workspace pod and opens a ready pull request.
The merger reviews the pull request and merges it.
After Done, a reflector looks back and proposes lessons.
The daemon dispatches a ticket only when every rule holds.
The ticket has the required labels, symphony in the default workflow.
It is in an active state: Todo, In Progress or Rework. In Review and Merging are parked.
A repo: label names the repository. Without one, the default repository applies.
cues.say: A repo label names the repository. Without one, the default repository applies.

cues.text: Its blockers are terminal, no person holds it, and a slot is free.
A ticket with Symphony's labels is told once whether it is queued. If not, a comment says what is missing.
When a ticket changes, the tracker sends a signed webhook to the control API.
The API wakes the daemon at once. A safety poll also runs every 15 seconds.
cues.say: The API wakes the daemon at once. A safety poll also runs every fifteen seconds.

cues.text: The daemon claims the ticket and takes a dispatch token. Only the first writer wins, so nothing starts twice.
Then it creates a runner Job for this attempt.
In the mocked run, the session started 44 milliseconds after the ticket.
cues.say: In the mocked run, the session started forty-four milliseconds after the ticket.

scenes.title: The runner and the workspace pod

cues.text: The runner is trusted. It keeps the tracker key and the GitHub App key.
It creates or reuses the ticket's workspace pod, with a volume for the session.
It mints a GitHub token for the ticket's repositories, for one hour at most, in a private file.
The model settings and MCP servers go into a private agent dir, made fresh for each attempt.
cues.say: The model settings and M C P servers go into a private agent dir, made fresh for each attempt.

cues.text: The pod has no ServiceAccount token, and it cannot reach the API or Redis.
The runner starts omp in the pod, through the Kubernetes API.
cues.say: The runner starts O M P in the pod, through the Kubernetes API.

cues.text: WORKFLOW.md has the settings at the top and a prompt template below.
cues.say: The workflow file has the settings at the top and a prompt template below.

cues.text: The template is strict Liquid, with two values: the issue and the attempt.
The default prompt asks for a ready pull request, and then a move to In Review.
The first step is to move the ticket to In Progress and post the Workpad, one comment edited in place.
On a retry, the last failure summary is added. Later turns get a short prompt.

scenes.title: Turns, live events and the hand-off

cues.text: An attempt is a series of turns, up to 20. Before each one, the runner reads the ticket state.
cues.say: An attempt is a series of turns, up to twenty. Before each one, the runner reads the ticket state.

cues.text: Every engine event goes to the session stream in Redis, and Tern shows it live.
The tracker tool runs in the runner, so the tracker key never enters the pod.
People can steer, follow up or interrupt. The runner applies each message at once.
The agent opens a ready pull request and moves the ticket to In Review.
The daemon parks the record and posts a session report with the cost.
If the merger blocks the pull request, the ticket goes to Rework, and the agent runs again.
The prompt adds a Rework section: fix only what the report marks as blocking.
The agent pushes to the same branch, marks the pull request ready, and moves the ticket to In Review.
The merger then reviews only the delta.
Meanwhile, a question on the pull request starts a short answer run. The ticket state does not change.
An attempt ends as done, continuation, blocked, failed or fenced.
A continuation runs the same attempt again, after a cooldown if nothing changed.
Blocked means the agent waits for a person. It called symphony_blocked, or three continuation turns changed nothing.
cues.say: Blocked means the agent waits for a person. It called symphony blocked, or three continuation turns changed nothing.

cues.text: A failure starts a new attempt after a backoff: 10, 20, 40 seconds, and up to 5 minutes.
cues.say: A failure starts a new attempt after a backoff: ten, twenty, forty seconds, and up to five minutes.

cues.text: After 8 failures in a row, the retries stop. The ticket is blocked, with a report of what failed and who acts.
cues.say: After eight failures in a row, the retries stop. The ticket is blocked, with a report of what failed and who acts.

cues.text: With triage on, the failure also opens an investigation ticket, where an agent looks for the cause.
If the agent goes silent for two windows, the daemon stops it and says so on the ticket.
A runner Job that ended without an outcome is requeued at the next tick.
The branch and the Workpad stay, so the next attempt continues the work.
When the agent needs a decision that is not its own, it calls symphony_ask, and names who decides.
cues.say: When the agent needs a decision that is not its own, it calls symphony ask, and names who decides.

cues.text: The daemon posts the question on the ticket, mentioning that person, and in Slack, with one button per option.
That person and the ticket's assignee also get it as a direct message.
An answer on the ticket, the pull request, Slack, Tern or the CLI counts. The first one wins.
cues.say: An answer on the ticket, the pull request, Slack, Tern or the C L I counts. The first one wins.

cues.text: If nobody answers in 15 minutes, the agent goes on and records its assumption.
cues.say: If nobody answers in fifteen minutes, the agent goes on and records its assumption.

cues.text: The question stays open. After 2 hours, a reminder goes out once, and a late answer still reaches the work.
cues.say: The question stays open. After two hours, a reminder goes out once, and a late answer still reaches the work.

cues.text: A person can also hold the ticket, with symphony takeover.
The daemon stops the attempt and keeps the workspace. symphony release gives it back.
cues.say: The daemon stops the attempt and keeps the workspace. Symphony release gives it back.

cues.text: An investigation asks for an answer, not a change. Its GitHub token can only read.
The agent writes a report on the ticket, files the follow-up work, and moves it to Done.
A large ticket becomes sub-issues, with the parent's labels and blocking relations.
Evidence, such as a test log, attaches to the ticket. On Linear, so does each run's session trace, redacted.
A later run can read the ticket's files back, through two host tools.
Two repo: labels make a multi-repository ticket, with one token and one pull request per repository.
cues.say: Two repo labels make a multi-repository ticket, with one token and one pull request per repository.

cues.text: When its repositories change, the ticket gets a new workspace.

scenes.title: Reconcile, sweep, and learnings after Done

cues.text: Each tick first reconciles every tracked ticket with the tracker.
A ticket that left the active states is parked. It keeps its workspace and uses no slot.
When the ticket is Done, the daemon starts a retrospective, then deletes the workspace.
A ticket moved to Canceled or Duplicate stops everything. Its questions close, and the merger closes its pull requests.
The reflector reads the diff, the reviews, the CI and the Workpad, and proposes at most three lessons.
cues.say: The reflector reads the diff, the reviews, the C I and the Workpad, and proposes at most three lessons.

cues.text: Code curates them into AGENTS.md, within a line budget. Unused lessons decay.
cues.say: Code curates them into the agents file, within a line budget. Unused lessons decay.

cues.text: It opens a learnings pull request. A person must review and merge it.
In a public repository, the work never names the ticket, and no learnings pull request opens.
A nightly sweep starts the retrospectives that were missed in the last seven days.

scenes.title: Certified on kind and against mocks

cues.text: On a kind cluster, a new ticket reached its runner Job in 7.7 seconds.
cues.say: On a kind cluster, a new ticket reached its runner Job in seven point seven seconds.

cues.text: A steer reached the agent in 13 milliseconds, and the next attempt resumed the same session.
cues.say: A steer reached the agent in thirteen milliseconds, and the next attempt resumed the same session.

cues.text: In the mocked run, the ticket reached In Review with a ready pull request in 22 seconds.
cues.say: In the mocked run, the ticket reached In Review with a ready pull request in twenty-two seconds.

cues.text: The investigation's push and pull request were refused, and the other scenarios passed.
